post.summary: Register an Entity List's sidecar as a Dataset
post.description: ASSURE-ENTITY-LISTS-RESIDUALS-1 (3). The explicit, manual action that creates the Dataset `entity_list_<id>` (`physicalRef: entity_list_<id>`) over the list's Parquet sidecar, through the same validated save path as a hand-authored Dataset (POST /components/dataset). No body. A list write never registers a Dataset; only this call does. Needs canAuthorWorkbench (the Dataset-authoring capability). Gates: no write root 503; unknown list 404; no sidecar on disk (no data root, or no list write since) 409; a Dataset of that id already exists 409 (never rewritten, so a repeat is safe); an approval policy for kind `dataset` 409 (refused, not held); the Dataset gate 422. No path-jail 403: the only path is built from a validated list id.

201.description: Registered. Envelope data `{listId, datasetId, physicalRef, dataset}`; `dataset` is the stored component as POST /components/dataset answers it.

409.description: No sidecar on disk, a Dataset of that id already exists, or the Space's approval policy governs Datasets. Nothing was written.

503.description: No write root, or Entity Lists are not installed in this edition.
